en_how: The random seed changes every 0.25 s (four drawings a second) and every line is re-jittered from it as if redrawn; crayon lines are the same polyline drawn three times offset and broken, colouring is zigzag scribbles that spill over the edges, felt-pen patches are translucent blobs, and the sun, family, dog and birds only swap between two or three whole poses.
